# 25 Camps on the 10:00–11:00 sector — Black Rock City 2026

Camp placements are official Burning Man Project data and may be shown to users from Aug 23 12:01am (the dataset terms lift the camp-location embargo then; this release ships Aug 27). Playa Pal is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or verified by Burning Man Project.

## Astral Lab

**Where:** 10:00 & F · **From:** Long Beach · **Landmark:** Red Dragon Fire Shade Structure and Goa Gil Alter · **Year:** 2026

Enjoy a different sound on the playa this year. Immerse yourself in psychedelic trance soundscapes that blur the lines of party and ceremony. Astral Project with us in our interactive musical playground. All beings, All hours, All welcome.

*More: https://astrallab.org/*

## Camp Bangers Only

**Where:** 10:00 & E · **From:** Truckee · **Landmark:** a pair of giant 35' tall speakers with LED rings · **Year:** 2026

An Aussie at heart camp with a global family. Adventurers and well, dare we say it, a bunch of legends welcomes you to our playground to play, drink, dance and laugh with real people from amazing places, doing cool shit with no pretentiousness. We have awesome places to hang, chill or get wild. Guaranteed awesomeness and welcoming vibes when ever you need. We will be rolling all week but the events not to miss are: Monday: 7PM till late - Bang Bang Manic Monday Party Wednesday 6PM till late - Wild Animal Party Friday 9-12am: Breakfast revival; Chill and disco beats, mimosas, bloody marys and ofcourse VEGEMITE TOAST & Sausage Sizzle (Bangers).

*More: http://www.campbangersonly.com*

## Camp Byte This

**Where:** 10:00 & C · **From:** San Diego · **Landmark:** 4x4 pink furry cube w/ mirror dome eyeballs · **Year:** 2026

This is BYTE's fluffy camp! Come by and dance with us, play on our immersive art, explore our mutant vehicle "Petabyte" and lube up your tappin' toes with our signature drinks at our furiendly bar. Warning: you may receive really cool gifts, hear the best music and feel the furry best vibes!

*More: https://thebyteproject.com/*

## Camp of the Rising Buns

**Where:** 10:00 B Plaza & B · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Large Lotus Bell tent and floating bun · **Year:** 2026

Camp of the Rising Buns is a community that celebrates the many gifts of the sun. Come to our Abuntent to experience the renewal of a new day while basking in the evaporative cooling powered by the gift of the sun's rays. Stop by at sunset daily for Bunset Karaoke + Rising Buns Bakery & Cool Your Buns Snowcones. "Sun's out, Buns out!"

## Cereal Thrillers

**Where:** Center Camp Plaza @ 10:15 · **From:** Ocala · **Landmark:** A Blue Sign "Cereal Thrillers" white carport · **Year:** 2026

Breakfast cereal bar where we serve that sugary cereal your Mom didn't let you have as a kid

## Elixai Dust Tribe

**Where:** 10:00 & G · **From:** Miami Florida · **Landmark:** N/A · **Year:** 2026

We are a welcoming dance and lounge camp offering a shaded daytime gathering space and curated electronic music experiences in the evenings. During the day, our frontage functions as a comfortable rest and connection zone with seating, hydration, and open conversation. In the evenings, we host thoughtfully programmed DJ sets focused on melodic house and groove oriented sounds in a contained and respectful environment. Our camp is open to all who wish to participate, dance, or simply relax. We prioritize inclusion, consent culture, and sound awareness while creating an energizing but intentional atmosphere. Stop by to move, meet new friends, and share the moment.

## Emergence with Buddha Lounge

**Where:** 10:00 & G · **From:** Ashland · **Landmark:** Buddha Lounge branded logo RV · **Year:** 2026

Facebook Emergenceartcar

## Fauxliage

**Where:** 10:00 B Plaza & B · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** FAUXLIAGE sign that is 11 feet long, with LEDs · **Year:** 2026

Our fake greenhouse offers a temporary refuge from the harsher elements of the playa. Come take a break in our cool misted space and relax to a nice soundscape. Stick around for some spontaneous DJ sets! At night, look for our 11' LED sign, colorful up lights, silhouetted plants! We'll also have an interactive 20 foot circular LED art piece that has some custom low resolution panels that light up with more participants and pulse to the beat of the music or the movement of the people in the circle.

*More: https://fauxliage.lol/*

## Feed tHE ARTists

**Where:** 10:00 & D · **From:** Atlanta · **Landmark:** 10:00 usually between D & G (yellow lights) · **Year:** 2026

Started in 2007 with Larry Harvey's blessing and support, FTA has fed tens of thousands of artists, musicians, dancers, builders, makers, dabblers, and generally curious wandering travelers. FTA actively models the concept of creating community through the sharing of delicious meals at BRC and all over the world. We are striving to elevate food to an art form, serving as a primary resource for playa food safety, kitchen design, and unforgettable cooking. You never know what we'll be cooking up next - and, whatever it may be, you are invited to prepare it with us and share a meal of some of the finest food ever gifted on the playa!

*More: http://feedtheartists.org/*

## Funky Town

**Where:** 10:00 & D · **From:** Montana · **Landmark:** Tessellated shade with 2-story wooden DJ booth · **Year:** 2026

*More: http://www.funkytownbrc.com*

## Golden Gate Project

**Where:** 10:00 & H · **From:** RENO, NV · **Landmark:** Golden Gate Bridge welcome sign with posts · **Year:** 2026

The easiest way to describe our camp is like giving directions to someone who's never been to San Francisco - look for the Golden Gate Bridge. At Burning Man, our camp is anchored by a 60-foot-long, 26-foot-tall replica of the Golden Gate Bridge, making it one of the most recognizable landmarks on the playa.

## Happy Hair Salon

**Where:** 10:00 & A · **From:** Salt Lake City · **Landmark:** pink and green striped runway on the corner · **Year:** 2026

Happy Hair Salon is your playa rave braid headquarters. We offer full hair extension makeovers with rave braids, bubble braids, and beard braids. We are a transformational hair salon where we showcase hair extensions as performance art. Come hang out in our antigravity chairs in the shade and watch the transformations. Burnt out? Playafied beyond belief? Come to Happy Hair and we will help you get your groove back with a brand new look.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61561295717121*

## Long Feng Camp

**Where:** 10:00 & K · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Red neon torii gate with flame towers & stage · **Year:** 2026

Long Feng Sound Camp is a living, breathing immersive soundscape where East meets West in rhythm, ritual, and release. By day, it hums with connection. By night, it ignites. A precision-tuned sound stage draws you into a field of movement and awe, while the Xiao Long Night Market unfolds nearby - a Chinatown dream woven with delights to tickle the senses including games, tea, and unexpected moments of play. This is a place to arrive, to lose yourself, to find each other. Follow the sound and join where East meets West.

*More: https://www.longfengartcar.com/*

## Lusty Chanterelle Kombucha Bar

**Where:** Center Camp Plaza @ 10:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Field of Mushroom Artwork and Kombucha Sign · **Year:** 2026

Whisky is out- Kombucha is in. The Lusty Chanterelle Kombucha bar is a place to cool down, relax, unwind, and drop in with good conversation and a cold non-alcoholic beverage with your fellow burners. Come with an empty cup and we will fill you up and help you feel at home with the most quaffable drink on playa.

## Maison Phi

**Where:** 10:00 B Plaza · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** A bunch of LED lights with the symbol of Phi! · **Year:** 2026

Maison Phi is your beautifully chaotic oasis in the dust where hydration, pancakes, yoga, and late-night dance floors all coexist in perfect imbalance. By day, come get revived at our Cucumber Water Station, reset with yoga, cool off with popsicles, or hang at our card games and pancake mornings. By evening, we serve up our iconic Dirty Chicken Martini Soup and roll out for golden hour art car rides with Fibonacci, our spiral-powered art car and cosmic counterpart?because Maison Phi and Fibonacci are two sides of the same frequency. By night, Phi Frequency takes over, music, movement, and connection under the stars. The House of Balance, Growth, and Natural Harmony and a bit of Chaos!

## Miki Beach

**Where:** 10:00 & F · **From:** Miami · **Landmark:** Miki Beach sign attached to truss & fake palm tree · **Year:** 2026

Miki Beach is inspired from an array of beach lounges in Miami and the Caribbean, and mimicking these beach lounge vibes, we are striving to create an open, breezy, colorful environment to relax and have fun. Miki Beach is your desert oasis so come celebrate with us at one of our playful parties, sip on one of our delectable libations, visit us for our Brazilian BBQ on Saturday or participate and become a winner on one of our silly activities such as the Miki Beach State Fair.

*More: https://www.mikibeach.org/*

## Nom De Plume

**Where:** 10:00 & 10:00 B Plaza · **From:** Yerba Mateville, Maine · **Landmark:** White 3 peak circus tent with a red stripe on roof · **Year:** 2026

We are a tea lounge that has yerba mate brewing the entire event in our circus tent. Come by to kick it, chill, and lounge. Relax while thriving, and drinking tea. The way life should be. We have a variety of other teas available throughout the week but always have yerba mate brewing. Sit down and hydrate while you start or finish your day. Yerba Mate Dub starts every day at 10:30am. Classic dub sounds from around the world as time turns elastic. Come have some tea.

## Opulent Temple

**Where:** Esplanade & 10:00 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Golden Pod booth, 4 large visual screens · **Year:** 2026

Opulent Temple. Sacred Dance to world Class Music

*More: http://www.opulenttemple.org*

## Orphan Asylum

**Where:** 10:00 & 10:00 B Plaza · **From:** Yreka · **Landmark:** Large lit up Orphan Asylum sign and banners · **Year:** 2026

Orphan Asylum is a hodgepodge crew of misfits who come together through careful planning, organization and a dash of straight anarchy to create a unique social experiment that has not been terrible yet so far. We rely on the kindness of strangers, and making them not so strange (or stranger, depending) by the end of the burn, as well as providing sanctuary to strangers on playa in need of a desert home. We don't charge dues and are instead entirely donation-based from our past and current orphans. Folks donate everything from money to org support to moral support to technical/skill support. Before the burn, we take in new camp members on an application-basis.

## Shake, Shake, Shake

**Where:** Center Camp Plaza @ 10:00 · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** Large sail shade with "SHAKE SHAKE SHAKE" sign · **Year:** 2026

Shake your tail feather as you enjoy an ice-cold, hand-shaken cocktails on a hot playa day. Voted "the best damn cocktail bar on the Playa" by our friends and regulars!

## T33M0

**Where:** 10:00 B Plaza · **From:** Sydney · **Landmark:** UV reactive lounge with a bar · **Year:** 2026

T33MO will get you back on the track If your bike is sick, we'll heal it for ya! If you're low on energy, try our refreshing icy slushies while relaxing in our cozy lounge.

## Tabernacle

**Where:** 10:00 & E · **From:** Thermal · **Landmark:** the metal palm trees · **Year:** 2026

## The Fluffy Cloud

**Where:** 10:00 & H · **From:** Washington, D.C. · **Landmark:** The giant UFO-looking Cloud and 360 spinning laser · **Year:** 2026

Home of the The Fluffy Cloud! A giant 360-degree immersive sound and light installation towering 3 stories tall and equally wide, the Cloud is a one-of-a-kind art amplification platform hosting a variety of musical interactivity throughout the week. From world-class DJs to interactive jukebox nights, to sound baths, join us under the Cloud every day of the week to get your taint-shaken by 200,000 watts of overhead sound, light and magic creating a 360 space purpose built for connection.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/realfluffycloud*

## Twilight language

**Where:** 10:00 & I · **From:** Bay Area · **Landmark:** Neon, lightning bolt and diamond totem · **Year:** 2026

A collective of creators on a mission to realize conceptual visual art and cultivate energy around it. Our passion is to create bold, interactive, innovative, and novel experiences. Or maybe it's just the world's best pizza party...

*More: http://thetwilightlanguage.org*

## Wok Paper Scissors

**Where:** 10:00 & I · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Chinatown Night Market Stalls · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to Wok Paper Scissors! Here in Sizzle City you battle for your stir fry. Come one, come all to Wok Paper Scissors, serving stir fry on the playa daily. To get your hands on a bowl of our delicious delights, you must first win a game of rock-paper-scissors! Do you have what it takes when noodles are at stake?
